Hi Jordan / Ana —

Thanks for the time yesterday. To get the hands-on POC across the finish line we want to align on three things this week: the technical runbook (how we'll execute the test), prompt set review (to ensure evals are representative), and the load window for throughput/latency benchmarking.

Proposed plan (pick one):
- Option A: Wed 20 Sep, 09:00–12:00 PT — dry run + 2-hour load window (preferred)
- Option B: Thu 21 Sep, 13:00–17:00 PT — full run + buffer for rollbacks

What we need from your side before the session:
1) Confirm which option works and who on your side will be in the run (Cloud/Dev/QA).
2) Any constraints on sustained RPS or max concurrency we should honor initially (we'll start conservative).
3) Sign-off on the prompt set attached (prompt-set-v2.csv) or any edits by EOD Fri.

Attachments: poc-runbook-v1.pdf (run steps), prompt-set-v2.csv, test-harness-config.yml (example).

If neither option works, tell us a couple of 2–4 hour windows next week and we'll adapt. I can loop in EngOps if we need a dedicated calendar invite with dial-in.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0132

Quick technical note from our side — thanks for the heads up on RPS. TL;DR: 1200 sustained RPS is fine for the initial run with the following expectations and preflight steps:

Preflight (client):
- Verify traffic shaping at the client-side gateway to avoid spikes >1500 RPS.
- Provide a sample 10k-request traffic file (we can consume CSV or JSONL).

Redwood run config (we'll apply):
- Model: open-llama-13b-quant (variant-1) pinned for the session.
- Batch target: dynamic with max_batch_size=64, max_latency_ms=75.
- KV cache warmup: 500 tokens split across warmup requests (see test-harness-config.yml).
- Fallback policy: automatic to variant-2 when p50 latency > 120ms for more than 30s.

Expected baseline at 1200 RPS: p50 ~ 60–80ms, p95 ~ 160–210ms depending on sequence length. We'll run a 15-minute steady-state followed by a short spike test to validate autoscaling behavior.

I'll schedule a 1-hour preflight slot Tue 19 Sep 16:00–17:00 PT for environment validation and a 3-hour run window Wed 20 Sep 09:00–12:00 PT. Please confirm who will upload the traffic file and who will own monitoring on your side (Grafana access or shared dashboards).

-Karthik
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
